nom: Exuviance Pure Retinol Correcting Facial Peel

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report a wide range of outcomes: several experienced significant redness, burning, or peeling — in some cases painful — while others, especially those using it once a week or with extra caution, report the peel worked gently with no irritation, breakouts, or sensitivity at all.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report good tolerance, including one who saw no irritation and credits her oily skin, and another who reports the peel visibly reduces oiliness right after use.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report positive results, including smaller-looking pores, a clearer and smoother complexion, and no breakouts.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal, non-sensitive skin reports the peel left her skin looking bright and helped fade a sun mark.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visibly softer, fewer, or less noticeable fine lines and wrinkles, along with firmer or tighter-looking skin, typically after several weeks of once-weekly use; a couple of reviewers, however, are unsure whether any improvement is due to this product specifically since they use it alongside other treatments, and one saw no change of any kind.
concerns.dehydration: Peeling, flaking, or dryness in the days after use is common and often described as an expected part of how the peel works, usually manageable with extra moisturizer; a few reviewers, however, report no dryness, flaking, or peeling at all, while one describes a severe reaction of painful, hurting peeling skin.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report the peel itself caused immediate redness or irritation, sometimes alongside flaking; others, however, report the opposite — a visible reduction in existing redness, including redness from acne scars and marks, with some experiencing no irritation or redness at all.
concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, acne marks, or sun damage, often over several weeks of once-weekly use, with some noticing a difference after a single application; one reviewer, however, reports no change of any kind from the product.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who mention acne report the peel helped clear active breakouts or reduced their frequency, with several noting improved texture and scarring from past acne, and none reporting new breakouts caused by the product.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the peel reduces the oily look of her skin almost immediately after use.

aspects.libelle: Mild tingling or stinging on application

extraits.texte: I wouldn't normally consider my skin to be sensitive, however, I don't know what it is about this product specifically that made my skin so irritated! I used the pad and the next day my face was so red and flaky. Over the days I had some peeling and the parts that were peeling hurt so bad. It might have just been a bad reaction I had to it but do use at your own discretion like any other product. For me personally this is a no.

I cannot leave an honest review because this made my skin red and irritated almost immediately. I do have some what sensitive skin and my redness does tend to flare up when I change my skin care routine so I can't leave an honest review based on what happened. All I can say is If u try it test out behind ear first.

I received the Exuviance Pure Retinol Correcting Peel to review complimentary from Exuviance and Influenster. The Pure Retinol Peels come as individually packed cotton rounds. I suffer from rosacea on my face, so due to extreme sensitivity, I was unable to apply retinol in that area. Instead I used it on my décolletage as well as my neck. I didn't feel any burning or irritation at all during or after application. My skin did not peel, but I do feel like this product made my skin softer with improved texture. I would recommend this peel to my family and friends who are looking for a gentle retinol product.

The peel is nice as well similar results to the serum but you have to be a bit more cautious with that one on what other products would you potentially be using it and will they interfere with each other and only using it 1-2 times a week when starting out. I would recommend if you are an acne prone combo to oily skin type.

Definitely I'm using this one a week in the afternoon and this product helped my skin a lot. My skin look amazing and bright help me with a little bit of sun mark. Using And avoid the sun. My skin is normal not sensitive.

I have been struggling with acne for years! Just a bit of background, I do struggle with Seb Derm on my scalp and it occasionally travels to my ear, face, and neck area, which has contributed to my acne breakouts consistently especially around my face. I have tried everything, with the exception of going to a salon for chemical peels and all. I have experimented with all types of facial cleaners, serums, masks, all claiming to reduce/control acne, clear dark spots (yes, I developed massive scars from my acne), and reduce open pores. I finally found something that works, and I am in love! I have only used this product for 2 weeks and I can already see the difference on my face. My scaring has reduced and the spotting developed from healing acne is fading. I have had minimal breakouts since I started using this product. I did see another review prior to buying this item to cut the pads in half to yield more usage since there is extra fluids inside packaging. I have found that to be a useful tip. I am waiting patiently for the brand to have a sale to buy more items since they are quite on pricey side. You will get your money's worth though.

This left an invigorating feeling on my skin! No irritation, redness, flaking or dry skin. My skin looked very nice after using this. My skin felt supple, hydrated and taut. No breakouts or sensitivity. I loved the age-fighting properties of this product and I felt powerful using this to fight lines and wrinkles. I had to stop myself from using this more than once a week!
